title: Rename Window Command To Action
description: In ui, os, and playground: rename the concept of "command" (as used for window kinds — actions and tools bound to a window) to "action". Every window kind can have actions; actions and tools are bound to windows. "Command" is being reserved for a different concept, so all naming referring to window commands must become "action" naming — types, functions, variables, props, file names, docs, comments — with no legacy aliases or backwards-compatible re-exports left behind.
summary: Verified the Command→Action rename is fully complete across the wgpu renderer stack: framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs and infinite/world/rs/lib.rs already use ActionDescriptor/ActionResult/ActionInvocationId/handle_action*/"handleAction" consistently, and both `cargo check -p semio-framework-renderer-wgpu -p infinite_world` and a full `cargo check --workspace` pass clean (one transient, unrelated procedural-plugin error vanished on retest and has zero rename-related code). A repo-wide grep for the renamed identifiers found no other in-scope leftovers — remaining "Command" hits belong to the deliberately-untouched compose-domain CQRS command protocol, or are inert historical ticket-scratch files. One actual leftover was found and fixed: .cursor/extract-playhost-regions.ts still referenced the old "CommandBus"/"CommandDescriptor" names, but was fully orphaned (its SOURCE path framework/product/playground/renderer/react/index.tsx no longer exists post-restructure to framework/product/os, and nothing in the repo imports or invokes it) — deleted rather than patched, per the no-migration-scripts convention.
